- Stable readiness: STABLE_BLOCKED because the sovereign signer trust policy remains inactive.
- RC2 remains provider NONE, EAC null and execution unauthorized.
- Sovereign Ed25519 trust root remains CONSTITUTION_READY_AWAITING_SIGNER with accepted_signers empty; GitHub/Sigstore attestation does not silently satisfy it.

Key rules:
- There is one canonical Ω and multiple generated surface projections; generated artifacts are not new canon.
- BUILT != REPRODUCED != INSTALLABLE != ATTESTED != SIGNED != TRUSTED != QUALIFIED != PUBLISHED != STABLE != AUTHORIZED.
- Identity-bound provenance is distinct from sovereign signer trust.
- A valid signature or attestation is cryptographic provenance evidence, not automatic safety, execution authorization, provider qualification or EAC.
- Publication is not stable-release qualification.
- Tag/digest-bound publication is distinct from platform-enforced immutable release state.
- Signing never repairs a defective artifact.
- Same semantic release digest does not imply byte-identical archive unless separately evidenced.
- Archive integrity does not imply schema/runtime contract conformance.
- Cross-platform reproduction does not imply platform installation qualification.
- Platform support is exact-release evidence; UNTESTED must never be presented as supported.
- The portable baseline is provider-free OMEGA_KNOWLEDGE_ONLY and carries no EAC claim.
- Release qualification must execute the portable runtime shipped inside the exact archive.
- Surface adapters may narrow representation/capabilities but may never rewrite constitutional, authority, assurance, witness, security, or claim-boundary semantics.
- Unavailable capabilities are disclosed/omitted; they are never simulated by prose.
- Installation is not authorization; provider discovery is not qualification; qualification is not execution authorization.
- Portable Ω MUST install usefully in OMEGA_KNOWLEDGE_ONLY mode with provider NONE before release promotion.
- Release payload and mutable runtime state are separated; generated install state is never canonical source.
- Provider discovery never assigns EAC. Stale/missing qualification cannot activate a qualified execution mode.
- Runtime fallback may narrow authority only when explicitly permitted and receipt-recorded; upward fallback is forbidden.
- Release packages contain no raw secrets; secret material remains external to release digests/evidence.
- ChatGPT/Gemini tool availability is a runtime capability fact, not a permanent prompt assumption.
- Gemini Notebook is source-first and should depend on explicit repository/source manifests rather than conversational memory.
- Distribution/release digests change when their bound semantic inputs change.
- Microsandbox is a reference provider behind the stable IEF ABI, not the architectural core.
- Feature support is not assurance evidence.
- Policy compilation precedes provider materialization.
- Cell profiles constrain/construct ExecutionSpec; profiles never call providers directly.
- Witness records bind observation, intent, authorization, plan, outcome, evidence, rejection, replication and adjudication without proving semantic truth.
- WITNESSED != TRUE and ATTESTED != SAFE.
- Effective authority may narrow automatically but may never silently widen.
- Reproducibility claims cannot exceed captured evidence.
- FORMALLY_CHECKED is bounded to the pinned external prover target/toolchain/dependencies and does not imply empirical truth, novelty, or peer-review status.
- No EAC-3 assignment exists until active-environment qualification passes.
- Provider-specific types must remain below the stable IEF kernel boundary.
